item.title: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls | Phoenix Cyclops Character Guide
item.description:
Unleash the power of Phoenix Cyclops!
An explosive all-rounder, Phoenix Cyclops controls the battlefield with devastating Optic Blasts, rushing attacks, and relentless close-range pressure.
In this Character Guide, learn how to generate Solar Shards and unleash his devastating Phoenix form, gaining incredible power at the cost of his own health.
Can you master the Phoenix Force before it consumes you?
Phoenix Cyclops is the first DLC character in MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls, available as part of the Year 1 Character & Stage Pass, included in the Digital Deluxe and Ultimate Editions.
The Year 1 Character & Stage Pass and Phoenix Cyclops are also available for purchase separately.

item.title: Line of Fire
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Line of Fire.

When a U.S. Marshal falls in the line of duty, a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy as a family of law enforcement agents become the target of a mysterious assassin. Bridging personal differences and crossing professional boundaries, the Hollingsworth family must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice... even if it means betraying their sworn code.

item.title: Cupertino
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Cupertino.

A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

item.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: S.W.A.T. Exiles.

After a high-profile mission goes sideways, Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson is pulled out of forced retirement to lead a last-chance experimental S.W.A.T. unit made up of untested, unpredictable young recruits. Hondo must bridge a generational divide, navigate clashing personalities and turn a squad of outsiders into a team capable of protecting the city — and saving the program that made him who he is.

item.title: Avatar: Seven Havens
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Avatar: Seven Havens.

In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

item.title: VisionQuest
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: VisionQuest.

Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding. Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S., and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepard, a mysterious boy who may be Vision's son, reincarnate. As Vision evades capture, he must confront his nature, resist Ultron's influence, and unravel the enigma that is his young companion if he's to survive.

Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military protege of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. Using everything she's learned from Jack Reacher and her time as a member of the 110 Special Investigators, Neagley puts herself on a dangerous path to uncover a menacing evil.

item.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: World War II with Tom Hanks.

For eighty years, the Second World War has remained the most devastating and defining conflict in human history. World War II with Tom Hanks is a landmark documentary event that reexamines the war through the lens of a new century. Told over twenty hours and guided by Tom Hanks, whose lifelong passion for this history has shaped some of the most profound screen portrayals of the era, the series captures the full arc of the war — from the rise of fascism in Europe to the fall of Berlin, from Pearl Harbor to Hiroshima, and the uneasy peace that follows. Each episode uncovers new dimensions of the conflict: the decisions that shaped the battlefield, the unseen networks that sustained the war effort, and the aftershocks that still shape our world today. "World War II with Tom Hanks" is the definitive retelling of that story for a new generation: a sweeping, deeply human portrait of how the modern world was forged in the fires of global war.

item.title: The Ghost in the Shell
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: The Ghost in the Shell.

Deep into the twenty-first century, the line between man and machine has been inexorably blurred as humans rely on the enhancement of mechanical implants and robots are upgraded with human tissue. In this rapidly converging landscape, cyborg superagent Major Motoko Kusanagi is charged to track down the craftiest and most dangerous terrorists and cybercriminals, including "ghost hackers" who are capable of exploiting the human/machine interface and reprogramming humans to become puppets to carry out the hackers' criminal ends. When Major Kusanagi tracks the cybertrail of one such master hacker, the Puppeteer, her quest leads her into a world beyond information and technology where the very nature of consciousness and the human soul are turned upside down.

item.title: The Westies
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: The Westies.

The Westies takes place during the construction of the Jacob Javitz Convention Center on the Westies' home turf in Hell's Kitchen, which promises a financial windfall. Despite being outnumbered fifty-to-one by the Five Families of the Italian Mafia, the Westies' legendary brutality and cunning have given them the leverage necessary to share the spoils through a fragile détente. But internal conflict between the brash younger generation and the old-school leadership threatens to set a match to this powder keg, which will sweep the Westies into the FBI's ever-deepening investigation into the Italian mafia.

item.title: The Chelsea Detective
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: The Chelsea Detective.

London's Chelsea neighbourhood is a beautiful borough for beautiful people, but it has a dark underside of deception, violence, greed-and murder. Bodies have a way of showing up, and things are rarely what they seem. DI Max Arnold and his partner must root out the truth and bring those responsible to justice, no matter their wealth or status.

item.title: Game Changer
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Game Changer.

The game show where there's a new, surprise premise every episode.

item.title: Lanterns
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Lanterns.

Lanterns follows new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

item.description:
🔥 50 SHADES OF OKKADU | Remakes Roast 😂
What happens when one blockbuster Telugu movie gets remade across different countries and regions? 🌍 You get Bengali, Bangladesh, Odia and Sri Lankan versions of Okkadu — each with its own unique twists, questionable logic, and some absolutely hilarious action sequences! 😂
In this roast video, we're taking a funny look at these different remakes and breaking down the illogical scenes, over-the-top emotions, unbelievable stunts, strange action choreography, and moments that make you go… “WHAT JUST HAPPENED?” 🤯
From physics-defying stunts to scenes that make absolutely no sense, these versions prove that one story can have MANY shades! 😆
This video is made purely for entertainment, comedy and parody purposes. The roast is directed at the scenes, filmmaking choices and situations, not at the people, cultures or countries involved.
😂 Watch till the end for some of the craziest stunts!

item.title: Taskmaster (AU)
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Taskmaster (AU).

Tom Gleeson stars as the Taskmaster, with Tom Cashman his devoted assistant. Each week the two Toms set five comedians a range of ridiculous tasks designed to bamboozle brains and put funny bones to the test.

Who'll master the tasks? The cleverest clogs will score the most points from the Taskmaster, while bemusement and bafflement will be rewarded with the fewest points. At series' end, the comedian with the most points will be crowned Taskmaster champion.

item.title: Alone Australia
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Alone Australia.

Follow ten brave Australians who are dropped in the merciless Tasmanian wilderness, completely isolated from the world and each other, stripped of modern possessions, contact and comforts, to self-document their experience. Who will survive the longest?

item.title: Colin From Accounts
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Colin From Accounts.

Centred on Ashley and Gordon, two single(ish), complex humans who are brought together by a car accident and an injured dog, Colin From Accounts is about flawed, funny people choosing each other and being brave enough to show their true self, scars and all, as they navigate life together.

item.title: Lucky (2026)
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Lucky (2026).

When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life — and a way out.

item.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe.

Set in the future, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom is tasked with restoring reality after he breaks a device built by Sheldon, Leonard and Howard, accidentally bringing about a multiverse Armageddon.Stuart is aided in this quest by his girlfriend Denise, geologist friend Bert, and quantum physicist/all-around pain in the ass Barry Kripke. Along the way, they meet alternate-universe versions of characters we've come to know and love from The Big Bang Theory. As the title implies, things don't go well.

item.title: Types of People on Roads | Shiva, Bhanu | Rejected Piece | Anvesh Creations
item.description:
On every Indian road, you’ll find all kinds of riders — the no-helmet gang, the rash drivers, the overconfident riders, the slow-motion philosophers who think deeply while riding, and even the ones who forget indicators exist 😭😂. But our video hits different.
In this relatable and fun sketch, we bring you “Types of People on the Road” — a comedy take on what we see every single day while travelling. From risky riding habits to hilarious thoughts inside a biker’s mind, this video is packed with situational humor that everyone has experienced at least once!
If you’ve spotted these characters in real life (or are secretly one of them 👀), let us know in the comments! Cast: Siva Kumar Bhanu Prakash Naresh DOP: Anvesh Written by : Ganesh Editor: Vijay

item.title: "What If Little Hearts Directed Other Directors" || Comedy Parody 🤣
item.description:
Prepare for the ultimate cinematic mashup! Ever wondered what the youthful Telugu rom-com Little Hearts would look like if it got the S. S. Rajamouli treatment? Or was remade as a gritty d**g-dealer thriller by Lokesh Kanagaraj?
The Little Hearts story of Akhil and Khatyayani just got a major, chaotic directorial upgrade. This is a full-blown parody exploring the hilarious extremes: SS Rajamouli: Exams are a war! Prashanth Neel: Coaching centers are coal mines! Lokesh Kanagaraj: The hero is a drug dealer like Sandhanam (Vijay Sethupathi)! Shankar: The final song is a $100$ crore visual spectacle!
Watch to see which director turns a simple love story into an epic, action-packed, or morally gray masterpiece.
Featuring: Mouli Tanuj Prasanth and Shivani Nagaram.
Which directorial style is your favorite? Let us know in the comments!
